Too thin to convert as the source of truth; used as evidence.

token: POST {baseUrl}/{apiVersion||'v3'}/api/Auth/RequestToken; calls: {baseUrl}/{apiVersion||'pesapalv3'}/api/{path} with Bearer token. All example paths are in openapi.json.

notes: Pesapal API 3.0 (JSON). Pesapal has two partial machine descriptions, neither complete: the live API's Swagger 2.0 (11 ops, no response schemas, no auth, missing GetIpnList and RefundRequest) and a Postman collection (8 endpoints, no responses). This spec unions all three sources: every documented endpoint (token, RegisterIPN, GetIpnList, SubmitOrderRequest incl. recurring fields, GetTransactionStatus, RefundRequest, CancelOrder), the swagger-only endpoints (RegisterCallBackUrl, GetTransactionByMerchantReference, QueryStatusByConfirmationCode; the test/health/FingerprintJS-webhook routes are kept but marked deprecated as internal) and the Postman-only Transactions/stk, 15 operations in all. Request bodies use the swagger DTOs verbatim (they expose more fields than the docs, e.g. settlement_instructions, flight_data) with doc descriptions layered on; response schemas come from the docs' sample responses, and the five undocumented endpoints have no response schema. best-effort/partial-docs because the login-restricted 'Additional API3 Endpoints' page (customer transaction query by phone/email) could not be read. Servers corrected: live is https://pay.pesapal.com/v3 (the old stub used /pesapalv3, which 404s on live). Adaptor caveat for the coordinator: Utils.js defaults apiVersion to 'v3' for the token call but 'pesapalv3' for every other call, so on the live host the default config gets a token then 404s on data calls unless apiVersion is set to 'v3'.
